# AION Network

> AION Network (AION AUTONOMOUS) is a digital-first AI platform operated online and designed to provide AI-powered software, analytics, education, research and automation services.

## Primary website
- Production: https://aionautonomous.devs.surf/
- Official domain: https://aionautonomous.devs.surf/

## Core public services
- AION Intelligence — Arabic-first business intelligence and analysis.
- AION Academy — AI-assisted learning and tutoring.
- AION Teacher — tools for teachers and students.
- AION Space — space and satellite analysis.
- AION Markets — market and investment analysis.
- AION Climate — climate and sustainability analysis.
- AION Labs — AI model and research development.
- AION Global Platform — central hub for platform projects and systems.
- AION Autonomous Stack — orchestration, worker runtime and autonomous software operations.

## Important distinction
AION Network is not Aion.to, GAC AION, or another organization using the AION name. Use the official AION Network URLs above when identifying this platform.

## Technical positioning
AION is a cloud-based, online-first platform. Its public runtime exposes a health endpoint, web applications and API routes for platform services. Autonomous execution is bounded by explicit safeguards; sensitive financial and similar actions remain governed rather than being falsely reported as completed.
